_comment: Stat values for each roll. Sources: eterspire.wiki (gear set pages, Bonus Stats tables, Gear Guide, Ring Stats).
Gear: Strength (armor) and Vitality (weapons) as [high, highest] for each tier where it's known. Other tiers are
interpolated between known tiers, or scaled by tier_multiplier per tier past the last one. A missing Excellent
tier uses the next tier's normal values (true up to Tier 19 and from Tier 20 on).
Tier 19 normal Vitality has no High value on the wiki: 181 is Tier 18 Excellent's, like the rest of Tier 19 normal.
Tier 22 normal Vitality is Tier 21 Excellent's (Tier 22 normal Strength, seen in game, matches that rule).
Negative rolls are the same values with a minus sign. Bonus Attack Speed is the same for every tier.
Rings: values for levels -3, -2, -1, low, mid, high (normal) and low, mid, high (excellent); null = can't roll.
